title.zh: Russia clears Sberbank for crypto trading ahead of December launch
title.en: Russia clears Sberbank for crypto trading ahead of December launch

current_state.zh: Russia's central bank authorized Sberbank (alongside VTB and other firms) as a licensed crypto exchange operator and custodian, with the lender preparing to offer BTC, ETH and USDT trading through its platforms starting Dec. 1, 2026.
current_state.en: Russia's central bank authorized Sberbank (alongside VTB and other firms) as a licensed crypto exchange operator and custodian, with the lender preparing to offer BTC, ETH and USDT trading through its platforms starting Dec. 1, 2026.
